exposure: Antenatal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) glucose values (Fasting Plasma Glucose, 1h, 2h, 3h)
cohort: The study included 1241 women with singleton pregnancies and gestational diabetes mellitus, who had available information on offspring weight for age, antenatal and follow-up OGTT, and additional potential predictors of LGA and AGT.
finding: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) on the diagnostic OGTT was the glycemic value that best predicted both large-for-gestational-age (LGA) newborns and postpartum abnormal glucose tolerance (AGT) in women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
birth_weight: Newborns were assessed for large-for-gestational-age (LGA) classification, which involves birth weight.
gest_age: Newborns were assessed for large-for-gestational-age (LGA) classification, which involves gestational age.
